query:
UPDATE appointment SET
             starts_at   = CASE WHEN $2 THEN $3 ELSE starts_at END,
             note        = CASE WHEN $4 THEN $5 ELSE note END,
             customer_id = CASE WHEN $7 THEN $8 ELSE customer_id END,
             calendar_hidden = COALESCE($9, calendar_hidden),
             draft       = $6
         WHERE id = $1
